6m（50 MHz）与 2m（144 MHz）为主，偶见 4m；远距离需借助余迹: Mainly 6 m (50 MHz) and 2 m (144 MHz), occasionally 4 m; long distances rely on reflection from the trail.
专为流星散射设计的弱信号模式，15 秒周期，可在极短余迹内完成一次交换。: A weak-signal mode designed for meteor scatter, with a 15-second cycle that completes an exchange within a very short trail.
中等流量，适合北半球 6m 试通。: Moderate activity; suited to 6 m trials in the northern hemisphere.
余迹短暂，交换要极简：呼号 + 网格 + 报告，一次 burst 完成。: Trails are brief, so the exchange must be minimal: callsign + grid + report, completed in a single burst.
全年最强流星雨之一，ZHR 可达 150。: One of the strongest showers of the year, with a ZHR up to 150.
北半球最壮观的流星雨，流星散射黄金窗口。: The most spectacular shower in the northern hemisphere — the golden window for meteor scatter.
哈雷彗星相关，中等流量。: Associated with Halley's Comet, with moderate activity.
哈雷彗星相关，南半球更佳。: Associated with Halley's Comet; better in the southern hemisphere.
大流星产生的强余迹可持续十几秒，足够完成一次完整 QSO。: A strong trail produced by a large meteor can last ten seconds or more, enough to complete a full QSO.
年初最稳定的流星雨之一，ZHR 可达 120。: One of the most reliable showers at the start of the year, with a ZHR up to 120.
最佳时段在流星雨峰值前后的清晨（当地 2–6 点），此时地球迎向流星群。: The best time is in the pre-dawn hours around the shower's peak (about 02:00–06:00 local), when the Earth is turning into the meteor stream.
流星进入大气层留下的电离余迹可反射 VHF 电波，形成数秒到数十秒的短时传播窗口: The ionised trail left by a meteor entering the atmosphere can reflect VHF waves, opening propagation windows lasting from a few seconds to tens of seconds.
用 6m（50.260 MHz 等约定频点）配合 MSK144 序列化交换呼号与: Use 6 m (agreed frequencies such as 50.260 MHz) with MSK144 in sequence mode to exchange callsigns and signal reports.
配合路径中点上方约 95km（90–105km）的电离余迹区判断双方共同可见窗口: Judge the window of mutual visibility from the ionised trail region about 95 km (90–105 km) above the midpoint of the path — the greyline is a concept of HF sky wave and does not apply to meteor scatter.
